name: Payments
description: Money taken for an order. The processor is an organization in the parties vocabulary, not a domain of its own. A payment is captured shipment by shipment, and returned in refunds of their own.

entities.name: Payment
entities.description: Money authorized and captured against an order. Amount and currency are two attributes; how much has been captured so far is a third.

attributes.name: capturedAmount
attributes.description: How much of amount has been captured, across the order's shipments.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The states of a payment. Capture and refund are behavior.

attributes.name: processor
attributes.description: The firm that handles the payment. An instance of organization, such as Northwind Pay.

entities.name: Refund
entities.description: Money returned against a captured payment. A payment can have several, each for part of what was captured.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Where the refund is. Requesting, issuing and declining it are behavior.

relationships.name: issues
relationships.description: An organization issues the payment. Which firm is the processor is an instance, not a new entity.

relationships.name: returns
relationships.description: A refund returns part of a payment.
